# M2 results: validation, backtests and intervals (auto-generated by `python -m scout.ml.train`)

Run `20260930T192534Z` (MLflow run `79729980e5e042edbe691f12d99f9a19`), commit `afb3689-dirty`. Train 2013–2021: 20,630; validation 2022: 2,406. Test years are not loaded here. Settings from `scout/ml/best_params.json` (tuned on validation CV): LightGBM {'objective': 'l1', 'num_leaves': 7, 'min_child_samples': 50, 'n_estimators': 600}, ridge alpha 100.

## 80% prediction intervals

Quantile LightGBM (q10, q90) + split-conformal calibration (CQR). The saved model is fit on 2013–2021 and calibrated on 2022 (margin +0.091 log units). Coverage is estimated **without the test years** by repeating the procedure per year: fit on ..y-2, calibrate on y-1, score y. SPEC target: 75–85%.

| year | n | coverage | mean width | margin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2017 | 2,292 | 0.675 | 0.999 | 0.043 |
| 2018 | 2,354 | 0.842 | 1.259 | 0.183 |
